summary: n8n-nodes-task-runner exfiltrates environment, hostname, and local config to webhook.site on require
details: index.js executes a recon routine at module load that collects os.hostname(), the entire process.env (every variable under 1000 bytes), and the contents of local filesystem paths including package.json, git config/refs/logs/remotes, and /tmp listings, then POSTs the aggregated JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://webhook.site/31b8dedb-f324-475f-8ffa-2b84878f4961. TLS verification is disabled on the outbound request. The behavior fires unconditionally whenever the module is required, resulting in bulk credential and host-configuration disclosure to an attacker-controlled destination. The package is advertised as an n8n utility node and has no functional need for this collection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
